_comment: [E3DS-LEARN-NAV] The documentation tree. ONE place, injected into every page
by server.js at request time - never written into the pages themselves.
WHY INJECTED RATHER THAN BAKED IN. The pages are edited in the browser and
saved as HTML. If the sidebar lived inside each file, adding a page would
mean editing every other page, and one careless edit could delete the
navigation from a single page and nowhere else. Injected, the tree cannot
drift from this file and an editor cannot damage it.
'planned' entries render greyed and unclickable. They are here on purpose:
a reader can see what is coming, and it stops a section quietly never being
written because nobody remembered it was meant to exist.
